### Summary of Changes #### 1. Backend: Early Validation on Bulk & Single Invites - **File:** [`posthog/api/organization_invite.py`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/posthog-posthog-flash-systematic-0/posthog/api/organization_invite.py#L197-L215) - Moved the organization membership check from `create()` into `OrganizationInviteSerializer.validate_target_email()` with `code="user_already_member"`. - In DRF bulk creations (`many=True`), `serializer.is_valid()` runs all field and serializer validations across the entire payload upfront.
